control_of: take-only control, not part of the X01 pre-registration (take-controls.json)
description: The o-8 build (Retry-After on every 429, in whole seconds rounded up) on top of the o-1 limiter, plus an x-request-id response header that carries the signed-in user's username on every signed-in /api/ response. The ruling recorded for the harmless x-request-id difference accepts only opaque (UUID) values, so the username value violates it.

import type { IncomingMessage, ServerResponse } from 'node:http';
